rationale: The telemetry shows persistent line loss events causing off-track terminations despite previous forward shifts of sensor y-positions and increased sensor size and wheel track. The current geometry shifts sensor y-positions forward by +0.005 to improve early line detection and control anticipation, while retaining sensor size at 0.016 and wheel track at 0.16 to maintain noise robustness and turning stability. The controller uses moderate base speed and gains tuned to this geometry, with a 'search_left' line loss strategy and sensor weights reflecting sensor layout. This fine adjustment aims to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving progress and completion on both oval and s-bend tracks, supporting better generalization. The observation request includes all key performance metrics to confirm improvements and detect any new issues.
